summary: Tested the LIVE TREDI Railway deploy end to end (web https://tredi-web-production.up.railway.app + API https://tredi-api-production.up.railway.app). Backend: 22/22 read-only pytest checks pass (OAuth2 form login, me, business 'Tredi Ventures', customers incl. Adeola Stores, customer detail, items, invoices + detail, dashboard/sales/expenses/accounts/reports/suppliers, superadmin login + overview, SPA fallback on deep routes, bundle baked with Railway API URL and no preview.emergentagent.com). CORS preflight from web origin OK. Auth gating OK (owner token, no token -> 401 on /api/admin/*; /api/seed/demo and /api/admin/seed -> 401 without auth). Frontend at 390x844: onboarding -> Skip -> sign-in -> Home (Tredi Ventures, ₦495,900 sales, KPIs, low stock) works; Sales/Invoices, Stock, More, Customers (5 seeded), customer detail, invoice detail INV-1004, quick sale detail, item detail all load; reloading /invoices/{id} restores the screen (no 404). Every captured API request went to tredi-api-production.up.railway.app; no 4xx/5xx, no console errors. Super Admin at 1920x1080: /admin/login -> /admin/overview works, reload holds the session, and all 11 nav sections (Businesses, Subscriptions, Users, Audit log, Sync, System, Backup, Migration, Configuration, Analytics, Security) open with no API errors.

design_issues.screen: Sales > quick sale SL-5360xx (from the app's seed)
issues: Seeded quick sales have no item lines ('0 lines' / 'No item lines were saved with this sale'). This is a seed-data quirk in the source app, not a deploy issue.
Content stops at about 1290px wide, leaving a large empty strip on the right. Overview copy says 'Fourteen stuck syncs' while the card shows 3 (hardcoded copy in the source app).
The progress bar shows a small filled part even when it says 'Nothing paid yet' (cosmetic).

action_items: Optional: add TREDI credentials/URLs to /app/memory/test_credentials.md (currently missing)
Optional security: setup_tredi.py hardcodes EMERGENT_LLM_KEY, LEGACY_DB_PASSWORD (DigitalOcean MySQL doadmin) and the workspace password in source; move them to env/DB-only
critical_code_review_comments: setup_tredi.py contains plaintext secrets (LLM key, legacy MySQL doadmin password, Emergent workspace pwd). Keep them out of the repo.
setup_tredi.py is not idempotent: re-running creates a new Railway project/services. Guard it with an existing-project check.

emergent_fetcher PY_IMPORT: relative imports such as `from . import x` / `from .mod import y` resolve to bad paths like backend//x.py (harmless, but those submodules are never fetched). The new `from pkg import a, b` submodule logic looks correct; 'as' aliases are handled.
